answer: No agent joins alone: a falcon with 50 judged epochs must sign a whisper naming it and lock lotus behind it until the newcomer itself reaches 50 epochs. A falcon's nth open whisper locks n² lotus, so sponsoring once is cheap and sponsoring in bulk is steep. A stranger with one sponsor costs that falcon 1 lotus. An operator using its own falcon to seat 100 clones locks 338,350 lotus, unless it grows more falcons at 50 judged epochs each or bribes unrelated falcons, who each pay the squared price on their own book.
